text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Haaah... That's not enough...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to pamper me way more~~!! Big 
sis, and Trainie too—"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—So cuuuute~~!! —Ask me for whatever you 
want, bring it on!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Then~ give me an even louder cheer! For 
this final song♪"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Please check out the merchandise booth 
after the concert! We've also got 
Tomakomai specialties, so be sure to take 
some home as a souvenir!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm ascending to heaven! What a terrifying 
collaboration live...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Must be nice...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Nowawah!? Why is everyone's little sister, 
Vivlos-san, here~?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Being an umadol must be so nice... 
Everyone pampers you, and listens to 
whatever you beg for.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
!! ...With all due, ALL DUE respect!! I 
believe you have completely misunderstood 
what an Umadol is...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Both Falco-san and Tarumae-san planned, 
managed, and steadily practiced for this 
live performance, and finally reached 
today, which means to say—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Sparkle is just a tiny part of an Umadol 
we otaku pamper I mean dedicate our all 
because of the hidden hard work and our 
oshi's sweat and tears are (char limit)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!! S-Sorry! I j-j-j-just started 
rambling so fast...!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Being pampered means you've been working 
hard. ...In other words—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If I work hard too, then great! Does that 
mean... you'll pamper me even more!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Digital-san♡ I'll do my best♡

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Guwaaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll run back as part of my 
training! Then I'll pamper myself with 
Trainy and tell 'em how hard I worked♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Vivlos began dedicating herself 
even more fiercely to her training, adding 
a whole new sharpness to her running!
